zh: 三个变换必须严格按题目顺序执行：先顺时针旋转指定角度，再按标志做垂直翻转，最后按标志做水平翻转；n 不超过 500，直接模拟即可。
旋转 180、270 度可以看成重复做 rotation/90 次顺时针 90 度旋转；顺时针 90 度旋转后的新矩阵满足 b[i][j]=a[n−1−j][i]。垂直翻转是整体反转行的顺序，水平翻转是把每一行左右反转。
读入矩阵后循环 rotation/90 次，每次按 b[i][j]=a[n−1−j][i] 生成新矩阵；若 vertical_flip 为 1 则反转行序；若 horizontal_flip 为 1 则反转每一行；最后逐行输出，同行元素用一个空格分隔。
en: The three transformations must run in exactly the stated order: first rotate clockwise by the given angle, then flip vertically if its flag is set, then flip horizontally if its flag is set. With n at most 500, direct simulation is enough.

A rotation by 180 or 270 degrees is just rotation/90 repeated clockwise 90-degree rotations; after one clockwise 90-degree rotation the new matrix satisfies b[i][j]=a[n-1-j][i]. A vertical flip reverses the order of the rows, and a horizontal flip reverses each row.

Read the matrix, then repeat rotation/90 times: build a new matrix with b[i][j]=a[n-1-j][i]. If vertical_flip is 1, reverse the row order; if horizontal_flip is 1, reverse every row. Print the rows one per line with single spaces between elements.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Apply the transformations specified by the problem one after another: a clockwise 90-degree rotation can be done with a new matrix `b[i][j]=a[n-1-j][i]`; after repeating it rotation/90 times, reverse the order of the rows if the vertical flip is enabled, and reverse each row if the horizontal flip is enabled.

## Proof of correctness

The formula places the element at row `n-1-j`, column `i` of the old matrix at row `i`, column `j` of the new matrix, which is exactly a clockwise 90-degree rotation. Repeating this transformation gives the specified angle; afterwards, reversing the row order and reversing the columns within each row implement the top-bottom and left-right flips respectively. Every operation is executed strictly in the order of the statement, so the result is correct.

## Complexity

O(n^2) time and O(n^2) space.
